beat: Dhika confirms Bobby saw panties; renewed shy conversation

lines.original: Dhika: Blush ..... did you see my panty ? she asked feeling a little awkward...
lines.local: Dhika sharmaate aur awkward feel karte hue: Kya tumne meri panty dekhi?

lines.original: Last time was just an accident when she fell down and Chotu and Bobby saw her blue panties, but they didn't see her bum, but this time.....
lines.local: Pichhli baar girne par accident se Chotu aur Bobby ne uski blue panty dekhi thi, par bum nahi dekha tha; is baar baat alag thi.

lines.original: Bobby: blushing.... yes miss... it looked cute...
lines.local: Bobby blush karte hue: Haan miss, cute lagi.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... the panty ? oh my goddddd.. don't embarrass me dear...
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, panty? Oh my god, mujhe embarrass mat karo dear!

lines.original: Bobby: The bum cheeks too... he said quietly...
lines.local: Bobby dheere se: Bum cheeks bhi.

lines.original: Dhika: flabbergasted... Bobbbyyy...is that you talking? hehe
lines.local: Dhika hairaan: Bobbby! Tum sach mein aise bol rahe ho? Hehe.

lines.original: Dhika was extensively surprised at Bobby's comment... yet she was a bit happy that he is open with her....
lines.local: Uski khulkar baat se Dhika bahut surprised hui, par thodi khush bhi ki Bobby ab uske saath open ho raha tha.

lines.original: and that was it... he again went into shying and blushing state...
lines.local: Bas phir woh dobara apne shy aur blushing mode mein chala gaya.

lines.original: She wanted to get him feel more open towards her.....
lines.local: Dhika chahti thi ki woh uske saamne zyada khulkar baat kare.

lines.original: Dhika: Bobby dear... if I should not getting dressed.... you need to speak up something that you thought of,.... but didn't due to shyness... she giggled.....
lines.local: Dhika: Bobby dear, agar tum chahte ho main abhi dressed na hoon, toh woh baat bolo jo sharm ki wajah se keh nahi paaye. Woh giggle ki.
